nameOfQualification: Operator - Computer Application and Assistive Technology -VI
description: Individuals will get proficiency in the computer application and assistive technologies available for persons with visual impairment to perform various functions efficiently to the maximum extent possible at par with sighted individuals. After completion of training, they can independently work in different capacities in office. They can also participate actively in the education, training and in social life
